definitions.average: Mean of valid noises within parent, then equal parent mean; support counts recorded.
definitions.I: Main I uses the intersection of requests with I_status PASS and finite ConflictCov_C for all five methods, separately per stage. Raw177 fields are unchanged.
definitions.area: RAW reference area measures retained original slots; actual output area measures deformed triangles. Bridges are separate. Neither certifies support.
definitions.external: External domain is original D0 BASE surviving unselected free slots. BASE is checked bitwise after canonical corner restoration. FINAL movement/deletion is reported, not asserted absent.
definitions.connectivity: Arithmetic set differences of existing exact source-slot/corner ledgers. Bridge faces are excluded from correspondence and remain in full177 metrics. No new intersection scan.
definitions.inference: Six repeatedly inspected development requests, three parents; no generalization or automatic-region claim.
definitions.visual: No semantic ratings are read or generated by this script.
